text: Alexey Mordashov holds 77.03% of PAO Severstal through Russian structures; the remaining 22.97% of the steel company's shares are free float.
short: Alexey Mordashov controls Severstal with a 77.03% stake.

source.name: PAO Severstal Investor Relations: Share capital
source.note: No publication date shown on the page; checked 2026-10-03.

additionalSources.name: Forbes profile: Alexey Mordashov & family
additionalSources.quote: Alexey Mordashov is the majority shareholder in steel company Severstal, which he ran as CEO for 19 years before resigning in 2015.
additionalSources.note: The profile also states: 'Severstal, in which he still has a 77% stake'.
